youtube_short.title: Buy 2 Get 1 Free Is Costing You $1,700/Year
title_alternatives: The BOGO Math That's Draining Your Wallet
Why 'Free' Items Cost You $1,700 Every Year
youtube_short.description: Buy two get one free feels like a win — but 73% of shoppers only wanted one item to begin with. The math is brutal: you 'save' $14 but overspend $28 every single trip. Four of these deals a month adds up to over $1,700 in unplanned spending every year. Retailers profit 25–40% more per transaction on BOGO deals. They're not being generous — they're engineering your cart size. Next time you see a BOGO, ask yourself: would I buy this at full price? If no, walk away. That's $1,700 back. #personalfinance #moneytips #savemoney #shoppingtricks #financetok

hook_line: 73% of BOGO shoppers only wanted ONE item
